title: Fishing Charters Victoria TailSpin Charters
specs: Fish for Chinook (King) Salmon to 50lbs, Coho (Silver) Salmon, and halibut to 200 lbs+
See stunning scenery of Olympic Mountain Range and aquatic wildlife including sea lions, porpoises, sea otters, bald eagles, and pods of Orcas
All persons must have a valid Canadian fishing licence with salmon conservation stamp if retaining Pacific Salmon

services.name: Book your charter
services.desc: Booking info: $150 CND deposit is required for all charter bookings. Final payment is due on the day of charter. If paying by credit card/paypal, payment is due 7 days prior to the charter date. Deposit refundable with 30 days notice of charter date. Deposit non-refundable and is credited toward a future charter on cancellations with less than 30 days notice of charter date. The Captain reserves the right to cancel the trip due to any uncontrollable circumstances, such as unsafe weather conditions and will fully refund your deposit. Credit Card payable through PayPal or E Money Transfer. Paypal will have 3% Administration

includes: use of 26 foot Osprey Fisherman boat
blurb: Tailspin Charters offers fully guided fishing charters in a 26 foot Osprey Fisherman with a professional, fully certified guide. They fish nutrient rich areas of Victoria, Sooke & Port Renfrew 365 days a year. Guests can experience fishing for Chinook, Coho salmon, and halibut, along with viewing local wildlife and scenery.
